notifications.appeal.overturned.defaultMessage: Se estimó tu apelación y se levantó la acción.
notifications.appeal.overturned.description: In an appeal_decided notification: the moderators granted the user's appeal and lifted the action.

notifications.appeal.upheld.defaultMessage: No se estimó tu apelación y la acción se mantiene.
notifications.appeal.upheld.description: In an appeal_decided notification: the moderators kept the action that the user appealed.

notifications.all.description: Link from the panel of notifications in the side column to the notifications page.

notifications.empty.all.description: Heading shown on the notifications page, and text of the panel of notifications in the side column, when the user has no notifications.

notifications.empty.description.defaultMessage: Cuando alguien te siga, te mencione o reaccione a tus publicaciones, aparecerá aquí.
notifications.empty.description.description: Text under the heading of an empty notifications page.

notifications.empty.filtered.defaultMessage: No hay notificaciones de este tipo
notifications.empty.filtered.description: Heading shown on the notifications page when no notification matches the selected type filter.

notifications.failed.defaultMessage: No se pudieron cargar las notificaciones
notifications.failed.description: Heading of the error that replaces the list of notifications when it failed to load; the reason follows.

notifications.filter.all.description: Tab on the notifications page that shows notifications of every type.

notifications.filter.boosts.description: Tab on the notifications page that shows only boosts of the user's posts.

notifications.filter.favourites.description: Tab on the notifications page that shows only favourites of the user's posts.

notifications.filter.follows.description: Tab on the notifications page that shows only new followers, follow requests and accepted follow requests.

notifications.filter.label.description: Accessible name of the tab list that filters the notifications by type.

notifications.filter.mentions.description: Tab on the notifications page that shows only posts that mention the user.

notifications.filter.posts.description: Tab on the notifications page that shows only the new posts of the accounts whose new posts the user chose to be notified of.

notifications.group.boost.defaultMessage: {name} y {count, plural, one {# persona más} other {# personas más}} impulsaron tu publicación
notifications.group.boost.description: Notification sentence for several boosts of one of the user's posts, grouped in one row. {name} is the display name of the newest account that boosted it; {count} is the number of the other accounts that did (1 or more).

notifications.group.favourite.defaultMessage: {name} y {count, plural, one {# persona más} other {# personas más}} marcaron tu publicación como favorita
notifications.group.favourite.description: Notification sentence for several favourites of one of the user's posts, grouped in one row. {name} is the display name of the newest account that favourited it; {count} is the number of the other accounts that did (1 or more).

notifications.link.account_status.defaultMessage: Ver el estado de tu cuenta
notifications.link.account_status.description: Link in a moderation notice notification to the page with the moderation actions on the user's account.

notifications.link.appeal.description: Link in a moderator's notification of a new appeal to the appeal's admin page.

notifications.link.followers.description: Link in a notification of follows ended by a suspension to the user's list of followers.

notifications.link.following.description: Link in a notification of follows ended by a suspension to the list of accounts the user follows.

notifications.link.registrations.description: Link in a moderator's notification of a new sign-up to the registration review screen.

notifications.link.report.description: Link in a moderator's notification of a new report to the report's admin page.

notifications.link.webhooks.description: Link in an administrator's notification of a disabled webhook to the webhooks screen.

notifications.link.custom_emoji_requests.description: Link in an administrator's notification of a custom emoji request to the requests tab of the custom emoji screen.

notifications.link.own_custom_emojis.description: Link in the notification of a decided custom emoji request to the user's custom emoji page.

notifications.load_more.description: Button at the end of the notifications that loads older ones.

notifications.loading.description: Visually hidden text that names the busy list of notifications while its first page loads.

notifications.moderation.action.description: In a moderation notice notification: what the action on the user's account does ({kind}, e.g. 'Suspension') and the reason category ({category}, e.g. 'Spam'), both already translated by the server.

notifications.moderation.until.description: In a moderation notice notification: when the action on the user's account ends by itself; {date} is a formatted date and time.

notifications.post.content_warning.description: A notification's link to the post it is about, when the post is behind its author's content warning: the warning only. {summary} is the warning's text.

notifications.post.open.description: A notification's link to the post it is about, when the post has no text to quote (pictures only).

notifications.report_resolved.account.defaultMessage: Se ha resuelto tu denuncia sobre {name}
notifications.report_resolved.account.description: Notification sentence: the moderators resolved the user's report; {name} is the reported account's name, a link to its profile.

notifications.retry.description: Button that loads the notifications again after they failed to load.

notifications.severed.account.defaultMessage: Los moderadores suspendieron a {name}. Perdiste {followers, plural, one {# seguidor} other {# seguidores}} y {following, plural, one {# cuenta que seguías} other {# cuentas que seguías}}.
notifications.severed.account.description: Notification sentence: the moderators of this server suspended a remote account, which ended the follows between it and the user in both directions; they are not restored when the suspension ends. {name} is the display name of the suspended account. {followers} is the number of the suspended accounts that followed the user, {following} the number of those that the user followed (either may be 0).

notifications.severed.domain.defaultMessage: Los moderadores suspendieron {domain}. Perdiste allí {followers, plural, one {# seguidor} other {# seguidores}} y {following, plural, one {# cuenta que seguías} other {# cuentas que seguías}}.
notifications.severed.domain.description: Notification sentence: the moderators of this server suspended another server, which ended the follows between its accounts and the user in both directions; they are not restored when the suspension ends. {domain} is the server's domain name. {followers} is the number of the suspended accounts that followed the user, {following} the number of those that the user followed (either may be 0).

notifications.signed_out.defaultMessage: Inicia sesión para ver tus notificaciones.
notifications.signed_out.description: Description of the sign-in state that the notifications page shows when nobody is signed in, under its heading and above the link to sign in.

notifications.title.description: Heading and document title of the notifications page.

notifications.type.admin_account_moved.defaultMessage: Una cuenta limitada por los moderadores se ha mudado a otra cuenta
notifications.type.admin_account_moved.description: Notification sentence to a moderator: an account that the moderators limit moved to another account, which does not get the limit.

notifications.type.admin_appeal.defaultMessage: Hay una nueva apelación pendiente para los moderadores
notifications.type.admin_appeal.description: Notification sentence to a moderator: a user appealed a moderation action on their account.

notifications.type.admin_report.defaultMessage: Hay una nueva denuncia pendiente para los moderadores
notifications.type.admin_report.description: Notification sentence to a moderator: someone reported an account that had no open report.

notifications.type.admin_sign_up.defaultMessage: {name} se ha registrado y está pendiente de aprobación
notifications.type.admin_sign_up.description: Notification sentence to a moderator. {name} is the display name, or the username, of a new user whose registration waits for a moderator's approval.

notifications.type.admin_webhook_disable.defaultMessage: El servidor desactivó un webhook que seguía fallando
notifications.type.admin_webhook_disable.description: Notification sentence to an administrator: the server disabled a webhook whose endpoint kept failing or answered that it is gone.

notifications.type.admin_custom_emoji_re.defaultMessage: Hay una solicitud de emoji personalizado pendiente de revisión
notifications.type.admin_custom_emoji_re.description: Notification sentence to an administrator when the request it is about is no longer known.

notifications.type.custom_emoji_request_.defaultMessage: Un administrador ha revisado tu solicitud de emoji personalizado
notifications.type.custom_emoji_request_.description: Notification sentence of a decided custom emoji request when the request is no longer known.

notifications.custom_emoji_request.submi.defaultMessage: Un usuario ha solicitado el emoji personalizado {emoji}
notifications.custom_emoji_request.submi.description: Notification sentence to an administrator: a user requested a new custom emoji. {emoji} is its :shortcode:.

notifications.custom_emoji_request.submi.defaultMessage: Un usuario ha solicitado una imagen nueva para el emoji personalizado {emoji}
notifications.custom_emoji_request.submi.description: Notification sentence to an administrator: a user requested a new image of a custom emoji they made. {emoji} is its :shortcode:.

notifications.custom_emoji_request.appro.description: Notification sentence: an administrator approved the user's request for a new custom emoji. {emoji} is its :shortcode:.

notifications.custom_emoji_request.appro.defaultMessage: Se aprobó la imagen nueva de tu emoji personalizado {emoji}
notifications.custom_emoji_request.appro.description: Notification sentence: an administrator approved the user's request for a new image of their custom emoji. {emoji} is its :shortcode:.

notifications.custom_emoji_request.rejec.defaultMessage: Se rechazó tu solicitud del emoji personalizado {emoji}
notifications.custom_emoji_request.rejec.description: Notification sentence: an administrator rejected the user's request for a new custom emoji. {emoji} is its :shortcode:.

notifications.custom_emoji_request.rejec.defaultMessage: Se rechazó tu solicitud de una imagen nueva para {emoji}
notifications.custom_emoji_request.rejec.description: Notification sentence: an administrator rejected the user's request for a new image of their custom emoji. {emoji} is its :shortcode:.

notifications.type.status.description: Notification sentence. {name} is the display name of an account that the user subscribes to, which made the new post that the notification shows.

notifications.type.announcement.defaultMessage: Los administradores han publicado un anuncio
notifications.type.announcement.description: Notification sentence to every user: the administrators of the server published an announcement, which the notification shows by its title.

notifications.type.auto_delete_limit.defaultMessage: El máximo del servidor para conservar publicaciones se aplicará a las tuyas
notifications.type.auto_delete_limit.description: Notification sentence: the server's maximum of the automatic deletion of old posts now applies to the user's posts, and after a grace period it deletes the posts that the user's own settings keep. The settings of the automatic deletion show which posts will go.

notifications.type.supporter_payment_fai.defaultMessage: Ha fallado un pago de tu plan de apoyo
notifications.type.supporter_payment_fai.description: Notification sentence: a payment for the user's supporter plan failed and the grace period began.

notifications.type.supporter_subscriptio.defaultMessage: Tu plan de apoyo ha terminado
notifications.type.supporter_subscriptio.description: Notification sentence: the user's supporter subscription ended, and the plan's benefits with it.

notifications.type.supporter_plan_retire.defaultMessage: Los administradores han retirado tu plan de apoyo
notifications.type.supporter_plan_retire.description: Notification sentence: the administrators retired the user's supporter plan.

notifications.supporter.grace.defaultMessage: Conservas las ventajas del plan hasta el {date}. Terminarán si no se realiza ningún pago antes.
notifications.supporter.grace.description: In the notification of a failed payment for a supporter plan, while the payment is still overdue: when the grace period ends; {date} is a formatted date and time.

notifications.supporter.ended.defaultMessage: {reason, select, lapsed {No se realizó ningún pago en los 7 días posteriores a un pago fallido, o la suscripción estaba en pausa.} reversed {Un pago se reembolsó por completo o se devolvió.} plan_retired {Los administradores retiraron el plan.} account_suspended {Tu cuenta fue suspendida.} account_closed {Tu cuenta fue eliminada.} staff {Un administrador canceló la suscripción.} other {La suscripción se canceló.}}
notifications.supporter.ended.description: In the notification of an ended supporter subscription: why it ended. {reason} is the reason code (not shown); each branch says one reason.

notifications.supporter.retired.defaultMessage: Tu suscripción no se renovará. Conservas las ventajas del plan hasta el final del periodo que pagaste, salvo que haya un pago atrasado.
notifications.supporter.retired.description: In the notification of a retired supporter plan: what happens to the user's subscription.

notifications.link.supporter_payment.description: Link in the notification of a failed payment for a supporter plan to the supporter page, where the user fixes the payment method. Not shown in the mobile app.

notifications.link.supporter.description: Link in the notification of an ended supporter subscription or a retired plan to the supporter page. Not shown in the mobile app.

notifications.custom_emoji_request.reaso.description: Label before the reason of a rejected custom emoji request in its notification.

notifications.type.account_moved.defaultMessage: {name} se ha mudado a otra cuenta
notifications.type.account_moved.description: Notification sentence. {name} is the display name of an account that the user followed, which moved to another account.

notifications.type.appeal_decided.defaultMessage: Los moderadores han resuelto tu apelación
notifications.type.appeal_decided.description: Notification sentence: the moderators upheld or overturned the user's appeal of a moderation action on their account.

notifications.type.boost.description: Notification sentence. {name} is the display name of the account that boosted the user's post.

notifications.type.favourite.defaultMessage: {name} ha marcado tu publicación como favorita
notifications.type.favourite.description: Notification sentence. {name} is the display name of the account that favourited the user's post.

notifications.type.follow.description: Notification sentence. {name} is the display name of the new follower.

notifications.type.follow_accepted.defaultMessage: {name} ha aceptado tu solicitud de seguimiento
notifications.type.follow_accepted.description: Notification sentence. {name} is the display name of the account that accepted the user's follow request.

notifications.type.follow_request.description: Notification sentence. {name} is the display name of the account that asked to follow the user.

notifications.type.mention.description: Notification sentence. {name} is the display name of the author of a post that mentions the user.

notifications.type.moderation_notice.defaultMessage: Los moderadores de este servidor te han enviado un aviso
notifications.type.moderation_notice.description: Notification sentence: a notice to the user from the moderators of the server.

notifications.type.poll_closed.defaultMessage: Ha terminado una encuesta en la que participaste
notifications.type.poll_closed.description: Notification sentence: a poll that the user created or voted in has closed.

notifications.type.quote.description: Notification sentence. {name} is the display name of the account that quoted the user's post in a post of its own, which the notification shows.

notifications.type.reaction.defaultMessage: {name} ha reaccionado a tu publicación con {emoji}
notifications.type.reaction.description: Notification sentence. {name} is the display name of the account that reacted to the user's post with an emoji; {emoji} is the emoji, or the :shortcode: of a custom emoji.

notifications.type.relationships_severed.defaultMessage: Una suspensión de los moderadores ha puesto fin a algunos de tus seguimientos
notifications.type.relationships_severed.description: Notification sentence when the details of the suspension are no longer available: the moderators of this server suspended a server or an account, which ended follows between it and the user.

notifications.type.report_resolved.defaultMessage: Se ha resuelto una denuncia que presentaste
notifications.type.report_resolved.description: Notification sentence: the moderators of the server resolved a report that the user filed. It never says how.

notifications.unread.description: Read by screen readers before the sentence of a notification that was new when the page opened.

notifications.unread_count.defaultMessage: {count, plural, one {# sin leer} other {# sin leer}}
notifications.unread_count.description: The number of unread notifications on the badge of the navigation item, for example '3 unread'.

notifications.account_moved.followed.description: Under the notification that an account the user followed moved: the user follows the new account instead. {target} is the new account's handle.

notifications.account_moved.requested.defaultMessage: Tu solicitud para seguir a {target} está a la espera de su aprobación.
notifications.account_moved.requested.description: Under the notification that an account the user followed moved: the new account is locked, so the user's follow awaits its approval. {target} is the new account's handle.

notifications.account_moved.blocking.defaultMessage: No seguiste a {target} porque lo tienes bloqueado.
notifications.account_moved.blocking.description: Under the notification that an account the user followed moved: the user blocks the new account, so did not follow it. {target} is its handle.

notifications.account_moved.blocked_by.defaultMessage: No seguiste a {target} porque te tiene bloqueado.
notifications.account_moved.blocked_by.description: Under the notification that an account the user followed moved: the new account blocks the user, so the user did not follow it. {target} is its handle.

notifications.account_moved.domain_muted.defaultMessage: No seguiste a {target} porque silenciaste su servidor.
notifications.account_moved.domain_muted.description: Under the notification that an account the user followed moved: the user mutes the new account's server, so did not follow it. {target} is the handle.

notifications.account_moved.target.description: Link from the notification that an account moved to the new account's profile. {target} is its handle.

notifications.type.service_closure.defaultMessage: Los administradores han anunciado que este servidor cierra
notifications.type.service_closure.description: Notification sentence to every user: the administrators announced the closure of the server.

notifications.type.service_closure_resch.defaultMessage: Los administradores han cambiado la fecha de cierre de este servidor
notifications.type.service_closure_resch.description: Notification sentence to every user: the administrators changed the dates of the announced closure of the server.

notifications.type.service_closure_withd.defaultMessage: Los administradores han retirado el cierre de este servidor
notifications.type.service_closure_withd.description: Notification sentence to every user: the administrators withdrew the announced closure; the server goes on.

notifications.type.admin_service_closure.defaultMessage: Ha pasado la fecha de cierre: cierra el servidor
notifications.type.admin_service_closure.description: Notification sentence to an administrator who may close the server: the closing date of the announced closure has passed, and the server closes only when an administrator closes it.

notifications.type.admin_error_group.defaultMessage: Se ha notificado un error nuevo, o un error resuelto ha vuelto a ocurrir
notifications.type.admin_error_group.description: Notification sentence to an administrator who manages the errors: the server or the web client reported an error of a new kind, or an error that was marked resolved happened again.

notifications.type.supporter_service_clo.defaultMessage: Tu suscripción de mecenas se ha cancelado porque este servidor cierra
notifications.type.supporter_service_clo.description: Notification sentence: the announced closure of the server cancels the user's supporter subscription at the end of its period.

notifications.type.voice_room_started.defaultMessage: {name} ha iniciado una sala de chat de voz
notifications.type.voice_room_started.description: Notification sentence. {name} is the display name of an account that the user follows, which opened a voice chat room that the user may join.

notifications.type.voice_room_invited.defaultMessage: {name} te ha invitado a una sala de chat de voz
notifications.type.voice_room_invited.description: Notification sentence. {name} is the display name of the host or a co-host of a voice chat room, who invited the user to it.

notifications.link.voice_room.description: Link in a voice chat notification to the page of the room.

notifications.type.admin_error_group_cre.defaultMessage: Se ha notificado un error nuevo
notifications.type.admin_error_group_cre.description: Notification sentence to an administrator who manages the errors: the server or the web client reported an error of a new kind.

notifications.type.admin_error_group_reg.defaultMessage: Un error resuelto ha vuelto a ocurrir
notifications.type.admin_error_group_reg.description: Notification sentence to an administrator who manages the errors: an error that was marked resolved happened again on another version.

notifications.type.admin_error_group_oth.defaultMessage: Se han notificado más errores nuevos o recurrentes en esta hora
notifications.type.admin_error_group_oth.description: Notification sentence to an administrator who manages the errors: more errors than the server notifies of one by one in an hour were reported.

notifications.link.error_group.description: Link of an admin_error_group notification to the page of the error group.

notifications.link.errors.description: Link of an admin_error_group notification about more groups to the list of error groups.

notifications.signed_out.heading.description: Heading of the sign-in state that the notifications page shows, instead of the notifications, when nobody is signed in.

notifications.mention.reply.description: Button in the row of a mention notification that opens the form to reply to the post that mentioned the user.

notifications.announcement.titled.description: Notification sentence to every user: the administrators of the server published an announcement. {title} is its title, a link that opens it.

notifications.link.announcement.description: Link from a notification of an announcement without a title to the announcement on the list page.

notifications.link.hook_decisions.description: Link in a notification to the page of decisions of the external review of submissions.

notifications.link.hook_appeals.description: Link of an admin_hook_appeal notification to the page of the appeal of a refused post that awaits review.

notifications.type.admin_hook_failing.defaultMessage: Las llamadas de una revisión externa siguen fallando
notifications.type.admin_hook_failing.description: Notification sentence to a moderator: calls of the external review of submissions keep failing, so submissions go through unreviewed or wait.

notifications.type.admin_hook_appeal.defaultMessage: Un usuario ha apelado una publicación que la revisión automática rechazó
notifications.type.admin_hook_appeal.description: Notification to a moderator: a user appealed a post that the server's automated review refused, and the appeal awaits review. Names neither the user nor the post.

notifications.type.hook_appeal_decided.defaultMessage: Los moderadores han revisado tu apelación sobre una publicación rechazada
notifications.type.hook_appeal_decided.description: Notification: the moderators upheld or overturned the user's appeal of a post that the automated review refused; shown when the appeal is no longer available to say which.

notifications.type.hook_appeal_upheld.defaultMessage: Los moderadores mantuvieron el rechazo de tu publicación. Sigue sin publicarse.
notifications.type.hook_appeal_upheld.description: Notification: a moderator reviewed the user's appeal of a post that the automated review refused, and kept the refusal.

notifications.type.hook_appeal_overturne.defaultMessage: Los moderadores cancelaron el rechazo de tu publicación. Puedes volver a publicarla.
notifications.type.hook_appeal_overturne.description: Notification: a moderator overturned the automated review's refusal of the user's post. The post is not restored; the user posts it again, and their posts are no longer reviewed.

notifications.unknown.description: Sentence of a notification whose type this version of the web client does not know yet.

notifications.auto_delete_limit.detail.defaultMessage: A partir del {date}, se eliminarán tus publicaciones con más de {days, plural, one {# día} other {# días}}, salvo las que este servidor te permita conservar. Hasta entonces se aplica tu propia configuración.
notifications.auto_delete_limit.detail.description: In the notification that the server's maximum of the automatic deletion binds the user: {date} is the formatted date it starts to delete their posts, {days} the most days a post is kept.

notifications.link.auto_delete.description: Link in the notification of the server's maximum of the automatic deletion to the settings of the automatic deletion, which preview what goes.
